source_anchor.section: V3.2 amendment 23C - Adversarially hardened readiness definition

invariants.label: single-transactional-commit-authority
invariants.text: One transactional commit authority defines every live kernel mutation in each topology; per-document JSONL files are not the serving authority.

invariants.label: snapshot-sequence-boundary-identity
invariants.text: Every KernelSnapshot is identified by a committed sequence boundary and required payload state; timestamps alone do not establish membership or causality.

invariants.label: crash-injection-no-partial-state
invariants.text: Multi-record mutations, decisions, publication pointers, source cursors, and effects survive crash injection without partial state masquerading as complete.

invariants.label: blob-vs-observation-identity
invariants.text: Blob identity and Observation/evidence identity remain separate under deduplication.

invariants.label: core-record-semantics-versioned
invariants.text: ClaimAssertion, ClaimAssessment, NativeObject/NativeFact, Decision, Invalidation, Patch, and ArtifactRevision semantics are implemented and versioned.

invariants.label: canonical-id-cross-platform
invariants.text: Canonical IDs pass cross-language/x86_64/ARM64 fixtures; raw Unicode, semantic normalization, decimal precision, and fixed-point geometry are not conflated.

invariants.label: materialized-reads-rebuild-from-pin
invariants.text: Materialized reads meet the local SLA without replaying raw logical streams; every generation can be rebuilt from its pinned snapshot.

invariants.label: gc-retention-holds
invariants.text: Proof-closure GC cannot delete inspectable/replayable dependencies required by live proofs, legal hold, audit, or active readers.

invariants.label: schema-evolution-no-self-heal
invariants.text: Schema evolution preserves historical field meaning and old-record readability; production startup performs no opportunistic schema self-heal.

invariants.label: layered-anchor-selectors-honest
invariants.text: Source anchors use layered native/text/structure/geometry/state selectors and report exact, deterministic/reviewed mapped, semantic candidate, stale, or unresolved honestly.

invariants.label: similarity-never-exact-identity
invariants.text: Semantic similarity alone never establishes exact identity for a paraphrased/moved source.

invariants.label: reading-order-partial-graph
invariants.text: Reading order is a partial-order graph with bounded contextual re-evaluation; specialist crop output cannot be inserted blindly.

invariants.label: cross-page-fragment-preservation
invariants.text: Cross-page continuations and multi-page tables preserve all source fragments, alternatives, and provenance.

invariants.label: patch-conflict-rule
invariants.text: Non-commutative concurrent patches conflict or rebase under a tested rule; patch order cannot silently choose truth.

invariants.label: reversal-reconstructs-prior
invariants.text: Reversal reconstructs a prior derived revision; no claim is made that a lossy view recreates discarded source information.

invariants.label: dependency-completeness-declared
invariants.text: Dependency completeness is declared. Unknown semantic dependencies widen invalidation scope.

invariants.label: incremental-equals-clean-rebuild
invariants.text: Randomized incremental updates produce the same declared outputs as clean rebuilds, or incrementality is disabled for that format/operator.

invariants.label: redaction-all-paths
invariants.text: Redaction removes or denies every affected text, image, cache, index, visual vector, export, and cursor path required by policy.

invariants.label: dependency-risk-disclosure-only
invariants.text: `dependency_risk_profile` is treated as disclosure/risk metadata, not proof of model independence; unknown lineage is not counted as independent.

invariants.label: model-agreement-never-high-risk
invariants.text: High-risk verification cannot be established by model agreement alone.

invariants.label: proof-graph-cycle-integrity
invariants.text: Proof graphs reject cycles/self-support and verify source/crop/topology integrity before accepting downstream validators.

invariants.label: verification-status-relative
invariants.text: Verification status is claim/region/workflow/policy/snapshot-relative and does not make an entire document unusable because one region is unresolved.

invariants.label: calibration-artifact-discipline
invariants.text: Calibration/risk artifacts name their population, sample, assumptions, confidence interval, shift tests, and expiry; zero observed catastrophic failures are not reported as zero risk.

invariants.label: bounded-continuation-termination
invariants.text: Bounded continuation terminates under cycles, budget exhaustion, or repeated failure and emits a deterministic outcome.

invariants.label: routing-stays-shadow-until-proven
invariants.text: EVC-style routing remains shadow/offline until it beats fixed rules and best-single-engine baselines under held-out shift and catastrophic utility.

invariants.label: review-policy-operational
invariants.text: Review coverage, queue time, and bypass behavior demonstrate that the verification policy is operationally usable.

invariants.label: no-training-routing-transparency
invariants.text: The no-training constraint does not block transparent routing to user-supplied or managed trained specialists; the extraction displacement report compares direct specialist use.

invariants.label: runtime-isolation-measured
invariants.text: Isolation occurs at runtime-family boundaries and passes a measured locality/copy/latency comparison against the monolithic baseline.

invariants.label: artifact-handle-data-plane
invariants.text: Large page/tensor data moves through verified artifact handles or an equally efficient fallback, not repeated JSON/gRPC serialization.

invariants.label: admission-memory-envelope
invariants.text: Admission uses the pinned preprocessor's actual/upper-bound visual-token and memory envelope; dynamic-resolution stress does not create uncontrolled OOM cascades.

invariants.label: model-lease-anti-eviction
invariants.text: Active model leases prevent eviction; cold-start/queue/load cost appears in routing and user-visible outcomes.

invariants.label: exactly-one-fenced-publication
invariants.text: At-least-once duplicate execution is safe; exactly one fenced accepted publication occurs.

invariants.label: heartbeat-renewal-evidence
invariants.text: Heartbeat renewal requires a responsive control loop and active request evidence, not a blind detached timestamp updater.

invariants.label: no-scarce-child-slots-fairness
invariants.text: Parent coordinators hold no scarce child slots; mixed large/small workloads meet fairness and bounded-fan-out gates.

invariants.label: slow-client-nonblocking-events
invariants.text: Slow/disconnected event clients cannot block execution or terminal state; durable semantic events replay by authoritative sequence.

invariants.label: publication-set-atomicity
invariants.text: Progressive artifacts are provisional until a complete PublicationSet passes required gates; a late failure cannot expose a mixed stable generation.

invariants.label: external-effect-semantics-declared
invariants.text: External-effect semantics are declared as exactly-once, at-least-once, at-most-once, or reconciliation-required based on real destination primitives.

invariants.label: failure-injection-truthful-outcomes
invariants.text: Cancellation, failover, disk/WAL/shared-memory pressure, database outage, and model-service crash produce truthful terminal/recovery outcomes.

invariants.label: content-vs-policy-revision-separation
invariants.text: ContentRevision and AccessPolicyRevision are separate; ACL-only changes preserve content/citation identity.

invariants.label: source-consistency-class-declared
invariants.text: Every source revision declares `native_atomic`, `version_pinned`, `stable_handle`, `best_effort_consistent`, or rejected consistency.

invariants.label: toctou-stable-handle
invariants.text: Probe/hash/parse use the same stable handle or staged immutable copy; local path/URL/object TOCTOU tests pass.

invariants.label: connector-idempotency-cursor-atomicity
invariants.text: Connector events are idempotent and gap-aware; source state and cursor advancement commit together locally; token expiry/reset triggers reconciliation.

invariants.label: revocation-slo
invariants.text: AuthorizationEpoch/group/inheritance changes meet the declared revocation SLO even without a document content event.

invariants.label: high-assurance-ranking-isolation
invariants.text: High-assurance search does not rank over forbidden lexical/vector/visual content; standard profiles disclose their weaker leakage boundary.

invariants.label: query-pinned-to-publication-set
invariants.text: Every query is pinned to one PublicationSet and compatible index/claim generations.

invariants.label: auth-recheck-on-continuation
invariants.text: Authorization is rechecked on every cursor/stream/asset delivery; epoch change invalidates continuation before protected output.

invariants.label: no-side-channel-leakage
invariants.text: Unauthorized resources do not leak through counts, ranks, errors, diagnostic traces, or unsupported timing assumptions in the declared profile.

invariants.label: disclosed-context-non-revocability-doc
invariants.text: Marker UI documentation states that already disclosed external-agent context cannot be revoked.

invariants.label: bounded-server-side-planning
invariants.text: `marker_query`/EvidencePacket completes priority tasks through bounded server-side planning; cursor traversal is a short inspection mechanism.

invariants.label: outcome-state-preservation
invariants.text: Tool outcomes preserve partial, review-required, abstained, policy-denied, stale, cursor-invalidated, and failed states across supported clients.

invariants.label: nl-planning-validation
invariants.text: Natural-language query planning is schema/policy/budget validated and cannot create authorization, identity, joins, or effects.

invariants.label: whole-unit-token-limits
invariants.text: Structural token limits never emit malformed tables, JSON, formulas, or code units.

invariants.label: packet-reuse-invalidation
invariants.text: EvidencePacket reuse is invalidated by source, ACL, policy, verification, redaction, citation, or renderer/tokenizer changes.

invariants.label: trace-not-entailment-proof
invariants.text: AnswerContextTrace is not represented as proof that the answer is entailed; material answer claims can be assessed separately.

invariants.label: mid-task-invalidation-honesty
invariants.text: Revocation, revision change, and late contradiction during an agent task invalidate Marker UI state/cursors without falsely promising deletion from external context.

invariants.label: stale-review-rejection
invariants.text: UI screens, approvals, exports, and operational status expose their as-of revision/policy/completeness and reject stale review commits.

invariants.label: scale-envelope-economics
invariants.text: Local/industrial scale envelopes report database rows, payload/object count, WAL/write amplification, retained generations, FTS/vector/visual storage, copy bytes, cold starts, review, and reprocessing—not inference alone.

invariants.label: visual-retrieval-selective-economics
invariants.text: Visual retrieval is selective and can be disabled; its downstream gain pays measured storage/update/ACL complexity.

invariants.label: subsystem-owner-rollback-kill
invariants.text: Every model/capability and architecture subsystem passes complexity-adjusted utility and has a support owner, rollback, expiry, and kill condition.

invariants.label: leadership-claim-discipline
invariants.text: Every leadership claim names workflow, source/policy/hardware profile, competitors, date, catastrophic budget, review burden, and unresolved limits.

invariants.label: negative-result-accepted
invariants.text: A negative result that removes routing, marketplace, visual, or generalized-language complexity is accepted as successful research.

invariants.label: final-displacement-test
invariants.text: The final displacement test asks whether a rational user can achieve a better accepted end-to-end outcome by leaving Marker UI; any remaining reason is integrated, measured, or explicitly conceded.
